title: MA61017: Fractals
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre requisite: Functional analysis, Topology, Measure Theory and
Integration.
Introduction: Fractal dimension, Housdorff fractal dimension, Fractal curves.
Uses of No constrained Chance: random coastlines, empty invocation of chance
versus actual description, Brownian motion, etc. Fractal Events and Noises: the
Cantor set, Dimensions between 0 and 1, Average numbers of errors in the
Cantorian model, Conditionally stationary error patterns, Clustering. Fractal
Clusters of Stellar Matter, Turbulence, Intermittency and Curdling: analysis
and geometry of turbulence, the problem of intermittency, and role of selfsimilar fractals. Singularities of equations of motion in physics as fractals.
Certain conjectures. Meteorites, Moon craters and Apollonian models of soap.
Applications of constrained models of chance: Joseph and Noah effects. Fractals
in physics: Bernoulli percolation, pseudo fractal sequences, single crystal
smectic filaments, and superconductors. Fractals, Brownian facets of rivers,
Relief and turbulence.
